verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Fenwick's Startup Resource Center and practice pages focus on general US startup issues (incorporation, vesting, equity comp) and the firm's offices are exclusively US-based, with no mention of UK EMI, German VSOP, Indian FDI/ESOP, French BSPCE or any jurisdiction-specific startup instrument content. Trademark practice mentions filing in 180 jurisdictions, but that is generic IP filing scope, not jurisdiction-specific startup/equity guidance. Missing for 10: any published content on non-US startup equity/instrument regimes, any international office or local-market expertise, any jurisdiction-specific guides for founders outside the US.
